name: Rattan Pikemen
headerMeta: Chivalric era · Pike/Polearm infantry · anti-cav · 95 leadership · Honour Tree (T2, Mastery)

order: bottom Bottom Line ('for poison, obviously' — per Amya guide). No node-by-node allocation grid was given in this guide (unlike the house-cards this session), only the line recommendation.

pitch: A cheap poison pike line that wins fights on stacked damage-over-time rather than the hit itself — stack 4-5 autos, back off, let the poison finish the job. Its charge doctrine hits for a flat number regardless of target, turning a filler unit into a surprise giant-killer against Iron Reapers or even Yanyuedao.

doctrines.name: Pike Assault Doctrine
doctrines.effect: Allows the unit to use the Pike Assault order; flat charge damage. Mandatory per Amya guide.
doctrines.note: flat charge damage, enables the Pike Assault order

doctrines.name: Poisons Doctrine V
doctrines.effect: +140 all armour penetration, +60 poison DMG per stack, stacks up to 2x.
doctrines.note: +140 all AP, +60 poison damage, stacks up to 2x

doctrines.name: Health & Defence Doctrine IV
doctrines.effect: +440 HP, +40 all defences. Top pick per Amya guide.

doctrines.name: Unit Damage Doctrine V
doctrines.note: "dream setup" replacing Leadership doctrine — rarely achievable since most warbands need Doctrine V slotted elsewhere

doctrines.ref: generic damage doctrine in place of Poison Doctrine V
doctrines.name: generic damage doctrine in place of Poison Doctrine V
doctrines.effect: Don't put — Amya guide verbatim: "Don't put DMG but Poison V."

battleRole.positioning: Good attack range on the pike — always look to flank rather than sit static. {1}
battleRole.tips: No need to perma-front-line during blob fights — back off a few seconds after stacking poison, then re-engage. {1} With the charge doctrine slotted, it can win matchups you wouldn't expect, including against Iron Reapers or Yanyuedao at their prime. {1}

cards.name: Iron Reapers
cards.why: house claim: Full Mastery pairs well with Iron Reapers (and/or MMAs) — 2023, likely stale under the current doctrine system

cards.name: Fire Archers
cards.why: TW pick for anti-cav duty; swap into Fire Archers when the enemy swaps

controls.notes: X-move then V to cancel the tail of the auto-attack animation once the damage pop-up shows, keeping the poison-stacking loop tight. {1}

gaps: No doctrines-and-mastery house card exists for this unit in either Discord server checked (StarBurst's card library or the Immortals units channel) - genuinely doesn't exist, not just missed.

Svarthe's 2023 house claim ('Full Mastery Rattan Pikes with MMAs and/or Iron Reapers') predates the current doctrine system and 'Rattan Pikes' as a name for this unit was never independently confirmed — flagged as likely-stale above.
No video guide covers this unit specifically - only sibling Rattan-family units (Roundshields, Vipers, Marksmen) turn up in the video sources we checked, not Rattan Pikemen itself.
No fight-rating (blob/duel/skirm/flank) entry exists for this unit from any source.
No formation (F1/F2) guidance found in any source.

Incoming Chaos-patch nerf (2026-06-22 shortlist): poison duration 6s→4s, poison damage per stack 250→140 — not yet reflected in the Amya guide's playstyle text or Poison Doctrine V numbers above; both predate the nerf.
No hero-pairing line in the Amya guide either, unlike most other Amya guides on this site - so no hero pairing is listed here.

patch.summary: Poison duration 6s→4s; poison damage per stack 250→140 (same poison nerf as Roundshields)
